images.alt:
A sprawling abstract collage unfolds like the weathered wall of an impossible civilization, assembled from fractured symbols, layered paint, digital glitches, and ghostly fragments of forgotten diagrams. 

Muted teal, moss green, charcoal, violet, rust, and dirty cream dominate the palette, interrupted by bursts of saturated electric blues, ultraviolet purples, acidic yellows, and scattered pixels that shimmer like corrupted data. The colors appear intentionally "wrong," as though they have chemically stained one another through years of exposure. Rather than harmonizing, they vibrate through simultaneous contrast, creating an uneasy but compelling visual tension.

Loose black sumi-e ink lines snake across the image, sometimes becoming elegant calligraphy, other times collapsing into frantic scribbles or looping graffiti. These marks weave through geometric blocks, halftone textures, paint drips, torn-paper edges, and noisy mosaics reminiscent of early digital compression. Cellular automata, quasicrystal-like tessellations, and Adinkra-inspired sigils seem to emerge and disappear beneath successive layers of paint.

Several ambiguous mask-like faces materialize from the chaos. Near the lower left, a rough Outsider Art face with oversized eyes and an arched doorway mouth appears assembled from scraps of pigment and weathered textures. Near the center, a pale blue triangular form resembles both a hooded figure and a folded paper icon surrounding a single circular eye. In the lower right, a larger face dissolves into black brushwork, with multiple eyes peering through overlapping grids and stains. Elsewhere, circular emblems, compass-like wheels, crescents, and partial glyphs suggest forgotten maps or ritual diagrams without resolving into recognizable language.

Paint splatters, dripping washes, scraped surfaces, and rough collage seams create the impression that the image has been built, erased, rediscovered, and rebuilt many times.
